items.titleTr: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations
items.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive has left the company following reports of a second extramarital affair.
items.articleText: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations - Published One of the AI industry's most important figures has resigned amid allegations that he had extramarital affairs with two women - one a suspected Chinese spy and the other a company executive. Chip-maker Nvidia hired a major law firm earlier this week to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's reported relationship with a woman who was allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset. Now he has resigned after its stocks plummeted on Wednesday following US media reports about a second alleged affair. Huang admitted, external earlier this week to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and he apologised for hurting her and their children. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. How was Huang removed? Nvidia's board met on Wednesday evening to decide whether its CEO should remain with the company. It had 11 directors on its board, including Huang. The firm's CEO could be removed with or without cause by a majority vote of directors. But that wasn't in the end needed - the board instead announced Huang had resigned as president, CEO and board member. It thanked him for his "immeasurable contributions" to Nvidia, which it said were "profound". There was no mention of the accusations of adultery. Who will replace him? Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO. It is less clear is who will replace Huang on a permanent basis. One possibility is Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky. He has been at the company as long as Huang, and for years led its product engineering work. Huang's children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez also work at Nvidia in senior roles, but they are relatively young and inexperienced. And there is also the option of Ian Buck, who runs high-performance computing at the firm. He developed the technology which allowed graphics cards to be used for other computing tasks, which enabled Nvidia to capitalise on the growth of AI. What we know about Huang's affairs A New York Times report at the weekend revealed Jensen Huang had a close relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who US intelligence officials believed was a spy for Beijing. She had previously been photographed with him on several occasions. The tech giant's board of directors launched an independent external investigation on Sunday following the reports. They earlier said Huang's interactions with the woman were "not unusual or unexpected". Then on Wednesday, the New York Times reported Huang also had an extramarital relationship with an Nvidia executive, Kimberly Powell, who reported directly to him. She did not respond to the BBC's request for comment. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the west coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. He worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with US President Donald Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. Who is Alice Huang? US officials believed Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. She was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. Her company had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, which the firm said had been investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singaporean government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. China has rejected the spying allegations as "entirely groundless". - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published2 days ago - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published2 days ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published1 day ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world - so the slump in its value which followed Huang's resignation hits investors large and small. The firm is also at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among US lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the concern is if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of companies like Nvidia, working with producers such as the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. He has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. The revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. What investigations are now under way? After news broke out about the first affair, Nvidia launched an independent investigation and hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. It will be led by Joon Kim, a former US Attorney for New York's Southern District who is now a litigation partner at the law firm. US President Donald Trump said the FBI was investigating the scandal, adding that Huang told him he had been unaware the woman he was with was a spy. Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November, but has yet to say he will comply. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for gaming. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. He bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure like Amazon, Google and Microsoft now use Nvidia chips. Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985 and have two children, Madison and Spencer. Earlier this week, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. items.articleTextTr: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations - Published One of the AI industry's most important figures has resigned amid allegations that he had extramarital affairs with two women - one a suspected Chinese spy and the other a company executive. Chip-maker Nvidia hired a major law firm earlier this week to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's reported relationship with a woman who was allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset. Now he has resigned after its stocks plummeted on Wednesday following US media reports about a second alleged affair. Huang admitted, external earlier this week to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and he apologised for hurting her and their children. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. How was Huang removed? Nvidia's board met on Wednesday evening to decide whether its CEO should remain with the company. It had 11 directors on its board, including Huang. The firm's CEO could be removed with or without cause by a majority vote of directors. But that wasn't in the end needed - the board instead announced Huang had resigned as president, CEO and board member. It thanked him for his "immeasurable contributions" to Nvidia, which it said were "profound". There was no mention of the accusations of adultery. Who will replace him? Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO. It is less clear is who will replace Huang on a permanent basis. One possibility is Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky. He has been at the company as long as Huang, and for years led its product engineering work. Huang's children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez also work at Nvidia in senior roles, but they are relatively young and inexperienced. And there is also the option of Ian Buck, who runs high-performance computing at the firm. He developed the technology which allowed graphics cards to be used for other computing tasks, which enabled Nvidia to capitalise on the growth of AI. What we know about Huang's affairs A New York Times report at the weekend revealed Jensen Huang had a close relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who US intelligence officials believed was a spy for Beijing. She had previously been photographed with him on several occasions. The tech giant's board of directors launched an independent external investigation on Sunday following the reports. They earlier said Huang's interactions with the woman were "not unusual or unexpected". Then on Wednesday, the New York Times reported Huang also had an extramarital relationship with an Nvidia executive, Kimberly Powell, who reported directly to him. She did not respond to the BBC's request for comment. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the west coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. He worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with US President Donald Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. Who is Alice Huang? US officials believed Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. She was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. Her company had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, which the firm said had been investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singaporean government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. China has rejected the spying allegations as "entirely groundless". - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published2 days ago - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published2 days ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published1 day ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world - so the slump in its value which followed Huang's resignation hits investors large and small. The firm is also at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among US lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the concern is if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of companies like Nvidia, working with producers such as the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. He has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. The revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. What investigations are now under way? After news broke out about the first affair, Nvidia launched an independent investigation and hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. It will be led by Joon Kim, a former US Attorney for New York's Southern District who is now a litigation partner at the law firm. US President Donald Trump said the FBI was investigating the scandal, adding that Huang told him he had been unaware the woman he was with was a spy. Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November, but has yet to say he will comply. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for gaming. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. He bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure like Amazon, Google and Microsoft now use Nvidia chips. Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985 and have two children, Madison and Spencer. Earlier this week, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him." "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. "But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." items.articleText: Colette Kress kimdir? Nvidia'da Jensen Huang'ın yerine geçecek isim belli oldu - ABD'li çip üreticisi Nvidia'da üst düzey yönetim değişikliği yaşandı. - Şirketin 2013 yılından bu yana finans direktörlüğünü (CFO) yürüten Colette Kress, Jensen Huang'ın görevden alınmasının ardından geçici CEO olarak görevlendirildi. Dünyanın en gelişmiş süper bilgisayarlarına ve yapay zeka veri merkezlerine güç sağlayan çipleri üreten Nvidia'da yönetim değişikliği yaşandı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket, finans direktörü Colette Kress'in geçici CEO olarak Jensen Huang'ın yerini alacağını açıkladı. Reuters'ın aktardığına göre yönetim kurulu, şirketin kurucu ortağı ve CEO'su Jensen Huang'ı, özel hayatına ilişkin ortaya atılan iddiaların ardından görevden aldı. Huang hakkında iki evlilik dışı ilişki yaşadığı, bunlardan birinin Çinli casus olduğu öne sürülen bir kadınla gerçekleştiği yönünde iddialar gündeme geldi. Colette Kress kimdir? Colette Kress, Eylül 2013'te Nvidia'ya başkan yardımcısı ve finans direktörü olarak katıldı. O tarihten bu yana CFO görevini sürdüren Kress, şirketin üç aylık finansal sonuçlarının açıklandığı toplantılarda da Jensen Huang ile birlikte yer aldı. Kress'in Nvidia'ya katıldığı 2013 mali yılında şirketin geliri 4,13 milyar dolar seviyesindeydi. Nvidia'nın 2026 mali yılındaki geliri ise 215,9 milyar dolara ulaştı. Nvidia öncesinde Microsoft ve Cisco'da çalıştı Kress, Nvidia'ya katılmadan önce önemli teknoloji şirketlerinde finans alanında görev yaptı. Kariyerine Texas Instruments'ta başlayan Kress, burada sekiz yıl çalıştı. Ardından 1997-2010 yılları arasında Microsoft'ta görev aldı. 2006 yılında Microsoft'un Sunucular ve Araçlar bölümünde finans direktörlüğüne yükselen Kress, bölümün finansal strateji, planlama ve raporlama süreçlerinden sorumlu oldu. 2010 yılında Cisco'ya geçen Kress, şirketin İş Teknolojileri ve Operasyon Finansmanı organizasyonunda kıdemli başkan yardımcısı ve finans direktörü olarak çalıştı. 2013 yılında ise Nvidia'ya katıldı. Eğitimini Arizona ve Southern Methodist üniversitelerinde tamamladı Arizona Üniversitesi'nde finans alanında lisans eğitimi alan Kress, Southern Methodist Üniversitesinde işletme yüksek lisansı (MBA) yaptı. Fortune'un 2024 tarihli haberine göre Kress, Nvidia'ya katıldığında daha önce çalıştığı şirketler arasında en küçük ölçekli olanın Nvidia olduğunu belirtmişti. Şirketin sonraki yıllarda yaşadığı büyüme, Kress'in finans yönetiminde görev aldığı döneme denk geldi. Colette Kress'in Nvidia'daki ücret ve sözleşme koşulları Nvidia'nın vekaletname bildirimine göre şirketin üst düzey yöneticileri, belirli süreli bireysel iş sözleşmeleri, kıdem tazminatı veya kontrol değişikliği anlaşmaları kapsamında çalışmıyor. Kress'in ücret paketi, dört yıl içinde hak edilecek kısıtlı hisse senedi birimlerini (RSU) de içeriyor. Düzenleyici kurumlara yapılan bildirimlerde, Mart 2026'da verilen bir hisse ödülünün dört yıllık hak ediş takvimine tabi olduğu belirtildi. Forbes listesinde 32'nci sırada Forbes'un 2026 yılında yayımladığı ABD'nin kendi servetini oluşturan en zengin kadınları listesinde Colette Kress 32'nci sırada yer aldı. Kress'in Nvidia hisselerinin değeri, çarşamba günkü kapanış itibarıyla yaklaşık 750 milyon dolar olarak hesaplandı. Bu tutar, Nvidia hisselerinin geçen ay ulaştığı zirve seviyelerinde 1 milyar doların üzerindeydi.

items.titleTr: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
items.summaryTr: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns
items.articleText: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says - Published Hundreds of millions of dollars meant to help tackle Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo are not reaching the intended recipients, a medical charity has warned. A report from Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) said that while the outbreak remained "out of control", front-line workers were going unpaid, lacked proper training and were struggling with shortages of essential supplies. It added that in some cases ambulances had run out of fuel. More than 5,400 people have died and 11,000 infected with Ebola in DR Congo since the outbreak was declared in May. This makes it the second-most deadly outbreak of the disease ever recorded. MSF has urged the Congolese government and UN agencies to "strengthen oversight and accountability" to ensure money already disbursed is effectively utilised. This means "ensuring response personnel are properly trained, paid, equipped, and supported, and directing resources towards areas where needs are greatest", it said. The BBC has asked the Congolese government for comment. MSF's warning adds to concerns raised by Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) last month, when it said that $700m (£527m) out of $962m disbursed to organisations implementing Ebola response was unaccounted for. At the time, Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya said it was too early to describe it as embezzlement, characterising the issue as a major transparency and financial reporting failure. The Congolese health minister echoed these concerns, saying that aid agencies were required to provide details of their work so the ministry could provide oversight but that only 22% had done so. "Our requirement is clear: transparency must be total. The response relies on a single plan, a single budget, and a single coordination," Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba said on X., external - What is Ebola and why is stopping the latest outbreak so difficult? - Published15 September In its report, external, the charity said: "Despite the vast amounts of money provided for the response, many frontline responders are left trying to contain the outbreak with empty hands and empty pockets." It also mentioned Ebola monitoring "surveillance teams that exist on paper but are nowhere to be seen on the ground". "Our teams are often left speechless by the dysfunctions they witness in many areas. Six months into the response, this situation is simply unacceptable," said MSF president Javid Abdelmoneim. One important way of stopping Ebola from spreading is contact tracing - finding all those people who had come into contact with an infected person and putting them into isolation. "Despite the resources officially allocated to this critical activity, surveillance remains deeply problematic," MSF said, adding that two-thirds of deaths were occurring in communities not treatment centres. According to British epidemiologist Neil Ferguson, more than half of the cases are going undetected, meaning the outbreak is likely to last another year, reports the Reuters news agency. MSF also raised concerns over "excessive concentration" of efforts in certain areas at the expense of other areas where needs were more urgent. It said the response was "too slow" in North Kivu province while Haut-Uélé remained "dramatically overlooked". In both provinces, MSF observed that teams were "inadequately resourced to respond effectively" with health facilities lacking essential items such as water, chlorine or triage systems. "This has turned some facilities into new centres of transmission, rather than places of care that contribute to containing the disease," MSF said. The epicentre of the outbreak is in eastern DR Congo, which has been wracked by conflict for many decades, with some affected areas under rebel control. There are very few good roads in the area, making it very hard to travel around. On Thursday, the UN and government warned that the areas worst affected by Ebola were also suffering from a severe food crisis, with almost 10 million in the region in dire need. The latest outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus, has spread beyond DR Congo borders, with cases reported in Kenya, Uganda and Nigeria. On Wednesday, the last person infected with Ebola in Kenya was discharged, marking a major milestone in efforts to contain the disease in the East African nation. The Bundibugyo species is relatively rare and has no approved vaccine or treatment - though trials are under way. Additional reporting by Emery Makumeno in Kinshasa More about the Ebola outbreak from the BBC: Go to BBCAfrica.com, external for more news from the African continent. items.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul ve VİOP piyasalarında yatırımcıların odağında Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası'nın yılın son Enflasyon Raporu bulunuyor. BIST 100, BIST 30, bankacılık ve sanayi endeksleri, öne çıkan hisseler ve vadeli piyasalardaki fiyat hareketleri canlı haberimizde.
items.articleText: Borsa günü yükselişle kapadı - Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, günü yüzde 1,24 değer kazanarak 11.811,19 puandan tamamladı. BIST 100 endeksi, önceki kapanışa göre 144,77 puan artarken, toplam işlem hacmi 137,9 milyar lira oldu. - Bankacılık endeksi yüzde 0,70 değer kaybederken, holding endeksi yüzde 1,02 değer kazandı. Sektör endeksleri arasında en çok kazandıran yüzde 4,37 ile metal eşya makina, en fazla kaybettiren ise yüzde 2,36 ile madencilik oldu. BIST 100 endeksi günü 144,77 puan (%1,24) artışla 11.811,19 puandan tamamladı. Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, günün ilk yarısında yüzde 1,48 değer kazanarak 11.838,61 puana yükseldi. Endeks, günün ilk yarısında en düşük 11.675,26, en yüksek 11.857,40 puanı gördü. Toplam işlem hacmi 56,1 milyar lira oldu. Bankacılık endeksi yüzde 0,49, holding endeksi yüzde 1,18 değer kazandı. Sektör endeksleri arasında en çok kazandıran yüzde 3,44 ile metal eşya makine, en fazla kaybeden ise yüzde 0,87 ile madencilik oldu. Günün ilk yarısında mali endeks yüzde 1,22, teknoloji endeksi yüzde 1,38, sanayi endeksi yüzde 1,98 ve hizmetler endeksi yüzde 2,05 değer kazandı. Önceki kapanışa kıyasla günün ilk yarısında BIST 100 endeksine dahil hisselerden 91'i yükselirken 9'u düştü. En çok işlem gören hisse senetleri Türk Hava Yolları, Tüpraş, Astor Enerji, Koç Holding ile ASELSAN oldu. Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, güne yüzde 0,08 yükselişle 11.675,26 puandan başladı. Bankacılık endeksi yüzde 0,80 değer kazanırken, holding endeksi yüzde 0,41 değer kaybetti. Sektör endeksleri arasında en fazla kazandıran bankacılık, en çok kaybettiren yüzde 0,99 ile menkul kıymet yatırım ortaklığı oldu. Dün yatay bir seyir izleyen Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, günü 11.666,42 puandan tamamladı. Borsa İstanbul Vadeli İşlem ve Opsiyon Piyasası'nda (VİOP) BIST 30 endeksine dayalı aralık vadeli kontrat güne yüzde 0,24 yükselişle 15.300,00 puandan başladı. VİOP dün akşam seansında normal seans kapanışına göre yüzde 0,48 değer kazanmıştı. Dolar/TL dün günü yatay seyirle 50,2319'dan tamamlarken, bugün bankalararası piyasanın açılışında önceki kapanışın hemen üzerinde 50,2570'den işlem görüyor. Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası (TCMB), makrofinansal istikrarı ve parasal aktarım mekanizmasını desteklemek amacıyla zorunlu karşılık uygulamasında değişikliğe gittiğini ve sekiz haftalık kredi büyüme sınırlarını yükselttiğini bildirdi. Düzenlemeyle tüketicilere kullandırılan ihtiyaç ve taşıt kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırı yüzde 3'ten yüzde 3,5'e çıkarıldı. KOBİ'lere kullandırılan Türk lirası kredilerde sınır yüzde 5'ten yüzde 5,5'e, KOBİ dışındaki işletmelere kullandırılan Türk lirası kredilerde ise yüzde 2'den yüzde 2,5'e yükseltildi. Öte yandan küresel endeks sağlayıcılarından MSCI, dünya genelinde endeks değişikliklerini duyururken, Türkiye'nin küçük ölçekli şirketler endeksine 2 yeni hissenin eklendiğini, 18 hissenin çıkarıldığını bildirdi. Buna göre, Astor Enerji ve Sabancı Holding Türkiye standart endeksinden çıkarılarak küçük ölçekli şirketler endeksine eklendi. Küçük ölçekli şirketler endeksinden de Ahlatcı Doğal Gaz, Altınkılıç Gıda ve Süt, Batıçim Batı Anadolu Sanayi, Batıçim Çimento Sanayi, Eczacıbaşı İlaç, Gen İlaç ve Sağlık, Hektaş, Işıklar Enerji ve Yapı, LDR Turizm, Lydia Holding, Margün Enerji Üretim, Odine Solutions, Pasifik Eurasia Lojistik, Peker Gayrimenkul Yatırım, Ral Yatırım Holding, Selçuk Ecza Deposu, Tera Yatırım Teknoloji Holding ve Türk Traktör çıkarıldı. Analistler, bugün yurt içinde TCMB'nin açıklayacağı yılın son Enflasyon Raporu ile haftalık para ve banka istatistiklerinin, yurt dışında ise İngiltere'de büyüme, ABD'de haftalık işsizlik maaşı başvuruları başta olmak üzere yoğun veri gündeminin takip edileceğini belirterek, teknik açıdan BIST 100 endeksinde 11.800 ve 11.900 puanın direnç, 11.500 ve 11.400 puanın destek konumunda olduğunu kaydetti. TCMB Başkanı Fatih Karahan, yılın üçüncü Enflasyon Raporu bilgilendirme toplantısında 2026 yıl sonu enflasyon tahminini yüzde 28 olarak yukarı yönlü güncellediklerini belirterek, "Enflasyonun 2027 yıl sonunda yüzde 15'e, 2028 yıl sonunda ise yüzde 9'a geriledikten sonra orta vadede enflasyon hedefi olan yüzde 5 seviyesinde istikrar kazanacağını öngörüyoruz." ifadelerini kullanmıştı.

items.title: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently?
items.summary: Chief financial officer Colette Kress in in charge of Nvidia for now, but several others are in the frame as potential successors.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently?
items.summaryTr: Chief financial officer Colette Kress in in charge of Nvidia for now, but several others are in the frame as potential successors.
items.articleText: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently? - Published Nvidia is now facing a scenario few would have considered until very recently - a future without Jensen Huang. The influential co-founder of the AI chip-making giant resigned on Thursday over reports of extramarital affairs, one of which was with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. Chief financial officer Colette Kress is in charge, for now, as the tech giant faces one of its biggest challenges - finding the right person to permanently lead the business that Huang helped create more than three decades ago and turned into one of the world's most valuable companies. We take a look at which candidates have emerged as potential successors. The finance chief Colette Kress has been an industry veteran for more than 30 years, having previously held high positions at tech firms like Cisco and Microsoft. Kress, who also serves as Nvidia's executive vice-president, has seen the firm's transformation from making chips for video games in the early 1990s to becoming an AI semiconductor powerhouse. She has "fronted every earnings call" alongside Huang and is a "familiar and trusted voice for the market at a time when it badly needs one," said Josh Gilbert, an analyst at investment firm eToro. But doing the job permanently could be a different story, said Gilbert, as the firm, known for its edge in technology, could want an engineer in the chair. The co-founder and the engineer Another option is Chris Malachowsky, who founded Nvidia alongside Huang and Curtis Priem, and is the only executive that shares the same level of seniority. Malachowsky has played a key part in developing the company's computing technology. Ian Buck, who oversees Nvidia's high-performance computing business, has also emerged as a potential candidate if the company is keen to put an engineer in the top job. Buck was among the early pioneers who helped popularise the use of graphic processors beyond gaming applications. "He could protect Nvidia's technological edge, but his ability to manage the wider commercial relationships and geopolitical challenges would face scrutiny," said Charu Chanana, investment strategist at investment bank Saxo. Today, Nvidia's leading processors are widely regarded as the gold standard for AI development. Huang's children also work at Nvidia in executive positions but are relatively young and inexperienced. Apple and Arm's top brass Nvidia is likely to favour an internal appointment initially but could look externally for a more permanent replacement, said Jun Bei Liu, founder and lead portfolio manager at Ten Cap. Several names of tech entrepreneurs outside of Nvidia have been floated by experts. Liu said Apple's former chief executive, Tim Cook, could be a possible choice as someone familiar with managing global supply chains, though she questioned whether he would be willing to leave the iPhone maker, where he is the chair. Liu and Chanana also suggested Rene Haas, chief executive of Arm Holdings, the UK chipmaking giant. Nvidia's processors are made with the help of chipmakers around the world, including Taiwan's TSMC and South Korea's SK Hynix and Samsung. Haas is familiar with leading a publicly-listed company and would bring semiconductor experience, though Nvidia's business model is considerably different from Arm's, said Chanana. "The challenge is finding someone who can combine Jensen's technical understanding, strategic vision and relationships across the global technology industry," Liu said. What now for Nvidia? Ten Cap's Liu had believed it was just a matter of time before Huang would step down as Nvidia's chief executive. "The issue is no longer simply about personal conduct," she said. "It is about corporate governance, national security concerns and maintaining confidence in the leadership of one of the world's most strategically important companies." Several major investment firms have downgraded their forecasts for the chip giant - a rare shift given investors' longstanding optimism about the company. An early indication came as markets opened in New York shortly after Huang's resignation was announced. Nvidia shares opened down more than 13%, wiping more than half a trillion dollars off the firm's share market value. Stacy Rasgon, senior analyst in US semiconductors at Bernstein Research, wrote in a note to investors that "our gut tells us we probably haven't fully probed the depths of what might be found here". Rasgon halved Bernstein's share price target for Nvidia and said: "We've had enough and prefer to watch from the sidelines." Ray Wang, chief executive of Constellation Research, said the crisis isn't so much an issue for the wider AI industry but rather one for Nvidia itself which has to consider if the person it appoints as its chief executive has the same appeal as Huang. "That's really what the issue is, because a lot of these partnerships and investments have been made because of the trust with with Jensen," he said. Additional reporting by Kali Hays Related topics - Published1 hour ago - Published2 days ago

items.articleText: Pentagon'da F-35 krizi: 2,5 milyar dolarlık yedek parça kayıp - ABD Hükümet Hesap Verebilirlik Ofisi (GAO), Pentagon'un F-35 savaş uçaklarına ait yedek parça envanterinde ciddi sorunlar yaşadığını açıkladı. - Rapora göre yaklaşık 17 bin parça sistemde kayıtlı değil. Kayıp parçaların değerinin 2,5 milyar dolara ulaşabileceği belirtiliyor. ABD Savunma Bakanlığı (Pentagon), milyarlarca dolarlık F-35 savaş uçağı programında yedek parça takibi ve envanter kayıtları konusunda yeni bir sorunla karşı karşıya. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ABD Hükümet Hesap Verebilirlik Ofisi (GAO) tarafından yayımlanan raporda, Pentagon'un F-35 parçalarının takibinde ve kayıtların güncel tutulmasında önemli eksiklikler yaşadığı ortaya konuldu. Rapora göre Pentagon, F-35 savaş uçaklarında kullanılan yaklaşık 17 bin yedek parçayı envanter sisteminde kayıt altına alamadı. Söz konusu parçaların toplam değerinin 2,5 milyar dolara ulaşabileceği ifade edildi. Mart 2026 itibarıyla F-35 programının ortak yedek parça envanterinde yaklaşık 31 milyar dolar değerinde 26 milyon parça bulunuyor. Bu envanterden ABD Hava Kuvvetleri ve Deniz Piyadelerinin yanı sıra uluslararası F-35 kullanıcıları da yararlanıyor. GAO: Pentagon çok az ilerleme kaydetti GAO'nun raporunda, 2019'dan bu yana yapılan denetimlerde F-35 programının envanter yönetiminde çok sayıda eksiklik tespit edildiği belirtildi. Raporda, "Savunma Bakanlığı, F-35 parçaları konusunda hesap verebilirliği sağlama ve sürdürme konusunda çok az ilerleme kaydetti" değerlendirmesine yer verildi. Pentagon'un envanter kayıtlarının güncelliğini yitirmiş, hatalı ve eksik olduğu vurgulanan raporda, önceki denetimlerde belirlenen sorunların da henüz giderilemediğine dikkat çekildi. 1 milyondan fazla parçanın takibi kaybedilmişti Raporda, GAO'nun 2023 yılında yayımladığı önceki bir denetimin bulguları da hatırlatıldı. Buna göre, ana yüklenici firmalardan biri 2018-2022 döneminde değeri 85 milyon doları aşan 1 milyondan fazla F-35 yedek parçasının takibini kaybetti. Söz konusu parçaların akıbetinin henüz belirlenemediği bildirildi. Kayıtlarda dikkat çeken değer hataları GAO raporunda envanter sistemindeki mali veri sorunlarına da işaret edildi. Aralık 2025 tarihli veri setinde yer alan kayıtların yaklaşık yüzde 6'sında F-35 parçalarının değerinin 0,01 dolar veya daha düşük gösterildiği belirtildi. Bu durumun veri giriş hatalarına işaret edebileceği değerlendirilirken, Pentagon'un mevcut kayıtlarının parça takibi ve mali raporlama açısından güvenilir olmadığı sonucuna varıldı. items.summary: Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat, COP31 Zirvesi'nde CNBC-e'ye yaptığı açıklamada AB'nin "Made in Europe" düzenlemesine ilişkin yoğun görüşmeler yürüttüklerini belirtti. Bolat, Avrupa Sanayi Konseyi'nin kasım sonu veya aralık başında karar alabileceğini söyledi.

items.summaryTr: Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat, COP31 Zirvesi'nde CNBC-e'ye yaptığı açıklamada AB'nin "Made in Europe" düzenlemesine ilişkin yoğun görüşmeler yürüttüklerini belirtti. Bolat, Avrupa Sanayi Konseyi'nin kasım sonu veya aralık başında karar alabileceğini söyledi.
items.articleText: Made in Europe için geri sayım: Bakan Bolat tarih verdi - Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat, COP31 Zirvesi'nde CNBC-e'ye yaptığı açıklamada AB'nin "Made in Europe" düzenlemesine ilişkin yoğun görüşmeler yürüttüklerini belirtti. Bolat, Avrupa Sanayi Konseyi'nin kasım sonu veya aralık başında karar alabileceğini söyledi. Ticaret Bakanı Ömer Bolat, COP31 Zirvesi'nde CNBC-e'nin sorularını yanıtladı. Yeşil dönüşümün finansmanı ve Avrupa Birliği'nin ticaret politikalarına ilişkin açıklamalarda bulunan Bolat, COP31 sürecinin çevre sorunlarından ekonomik dönüşüme doğru evrilmeye başladığını söyledi. Yeşil dönüşüme 300 milyar euroluk kaynak CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yeşil enerji dönüşümünün finansmanına ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Bolat, Türkiye'de yatırımı bulunan büyük bir İspanyol bankasının bu alana önemli miktarda kaynak ayırdığını belirtti. Bolat, söz konusu bankanın yeşil enerji dönüşümüne 300 milyar euro tahsis ettiğini ve yılın ilk 10 ayında 120 milyar euroluk finansman sağladığını aktardı. AB ile yoğun görüşme trafiği Avrupa Birliği'nin "Made in Europe" (Avrupa'da Üretim) yaklaşımına ilişkin de açıklamalarda bulunan Bolat, Türkiye'nin bu konuda AB yetkilileriyle yoğun temaslarda bulunduğunu ifade etti. Bolat, "AB yetkilileriyle yoğun görüşmeler yaptık ve medyayı harekete geçirdik" dedi. Avrupa Sanayi Konseyi'nin konuya ilişkin karar sürecine de değinen Bolat, kasım sonu veya aralık başında bir karar alınabileceğini belirtti. Türkiye'ye son 24 yılda gelen 295 milyar dolarlık yatırımın büyük bölümünün Avrupa kaynaklı olduğunu belirten Bolat, Avrupa ülkelerinin Türkiye'ye her yıl yaklaşık 75 milyar dolarlık ihracat yaptığını söyledi. Bolat, Türkiye aleyhine bir karar alınması halinde Avrupa'nın kendi yatırımlarını da boşa çıkarmış olacağını ifade etti.

items.articleText: Cevdet Yılmaz CNBC-e'ye açıkladı: Yeşil dönüşüm için yeni fon mesajı - Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Cevdet Yılmaz, CNBC-e'ye yaptığı açıklamada yenilenebilir enerji yatırımları ve finansmanına ilişkin mesajlar verdi. Yılmaz, sınırda karbon düzenlemesinden elde edilecek kaynağın bir fon aracılığıyla yeşil dönüşüme aktarılacağını açıkladı. Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Cevdet Yılmaz, CNBC-e'nin sorularını yanıtladı. Türkiye'nin enerji politikaları, yenilenebilir enerji yatırımları ve yeşil dönüşümün finansmanına ilişkin açıklamalarda bulunan Yılmaz, sınırda karbon düzenlemesinden elde edilecek kaynağın bir fon aracılığıyla yeşil dönüşüme aktarılacağını söyledi. Enerji altyapısında büyük yatırım ihtiyacı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yerli ve yenilenebilir enerjinin Türkiye'nin en temel politikalarından biri olduğunu belirten Yılmaz, enerji dönüşümünde yalnızca santral yatırımlarının yeterli olmadığını vurguladı. Yılmaz, "Sadece santralleri değil, şebekeyi de gerçekleştirmeniz, depolama altyapısını oluşturmanız gerekiyor ve bunlar büyük yatırımlara ihtiyaç duyuyor" dedi. Asyalı finans kuruluşlarıyla ilişkiler güçleniyor Türkiye'nin finansman kaynaklarının çeşitlendirilmesine ilişkin de değerlendirmelerde bulunan Yılmaz, Asyalı finans kuruluşlarıyla ilişkilerin geliştiğine dikkat çekti. Yılmaz, "Asyalı finansal kuruluşlarla ilişkilerimiz daha iyi hale geldi. Bu da büyük bir avantaj. Pazarlarımızı her alanda çeşitlendirmemiz lazım" ifadelerini kullandı. Yeşil dönüşüme fon desteği Enerji üretimi ve dağıtımında yeni modeller üzerinde çalıştıklarını belirten Yılmaz, finansmanı harekete geçirmek istediklerini söyledi. Yeşil dönüşümün finansmanına yönelik yürütülen çalışmalara da değinen Yılmaz, sınırda karbon düzenlemesinden elde edilecek gelirlerin bu alanda kullanılacağını açıkladı. Yılmaz, "Sınırda karbon düzenlememizle elde edeceğimiz kaynağı, bir fon aracılığıyla yeşil dönüşüme kaynak olarak aktaracağız" dedi.

items.titleTr: VakıfBank Genel Müdürü açıkladı: Türkiye son 3 yılda 50 milyar dolar kaynak sağladı
items.summaryTr: VakıfBank Genel Müdürü Osman Arslan, COP31 kapsamında Dünya Bankası ve üç uluslararası kalkınma bankasından toplam 5,1 milyar dolarlık finansman sağlandığını açıkladı.
items.articleText: VakıfBank Genel Müdürü açıkladı: Türkiye son 3 yılda 50 milyar dolar kaynak sağladı - VakıfBank Genel Müdürü Osman Arslan, COP31 kapsamında Dünya Bankası ve üç uluslararası kalkınma bankasından toplam 5,1 milyar dolarlık finansman sağlandığını açıkladı. VakıfBank Genel Müdürü Osman Arslan, COP31 Zirvesi kapsamında CNBC-e ekranlarına yaptığı açıklamada, Türkiye'nin ev sahipliğinde gerçekleştirilen zirveye finans kuruluşlarının da yoğun ilgi gösterdiğini söyledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Zirve kapsamında Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek'in katılımıyla düzenlenen toplantıda, dünyanın dört önemli kalkınma bankasıyla toplam 5,1 milyar dolarlık finansman anlaşması imzalandığını aktaran Arslan, söz konusu kaynaktan VakıfBank, İller Bankası ve Türk Eximbank'ın yararlanacağını ifade etti. Arslan, finansmanın Türkiye'nin kalkınma sürecinde farklı alanlarda kullanılacağını belirterek, şu bilgileri verdi: "Artık fosil yakıtı enerji üretim ağırlığının azaltılıp yenilenebilir enerjiye geçilmesi, afet ve deprem bölgelerinden etkilenen başta illerimiz olmak üzere oraların yeniden imar edilmesi, dijital dönüşüm ve karbon salınımının azaltılması ve atık miktarının üretim süreçlerinde azaltılarak atıklardan yeniden üretime geri kazanımın sağlanması gibi temel başlıklar var. Ayrıca gençlerin iş dünyasına katılımı, kadın girişimcilerin finansa erişimi noktasında onları daha güçlü hale getirmek gibi anlayışlar var. Biliyorsunuz kapsayıcılık da sürdürülebilirlik içerisindeki konu başlıklarından bir tanesi." "Son 3 yılda 50 milyar dolarlık kaynak sağlandı" Türkiye'nin uluslararası kalkınma bankalarından sağladığı finansmana ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Arslan, Bakan Şimşek'in de toplantıda paylaştığı üzere son 3 yılda toplam 50 milyar dolarlık kaynak temin edildiğini kaydetti. Bu tutarın 18 milyar dolarının Dünya Bankası'ndan sağlandığını aktaran Arslan, Asya Kalkınma Bankası'nın Türkiye'ye yönelik finansman desteğine de dikkati çekti. Arslan, Türkiye'nin geçen yıl Asya Kalkınma Bankası'na üye olduğunu hatırlatarak, "Geçen sene üye olduğumuz halde bugüne kadar 3,1 milyar dolarlık sadece Asya Kalkınma Bankası'ndan bir kaynak temin etmişiz ki bu çok önemli." dedi. "Türkiye diğer gelişmekte olan ülkeler için rol model niteliği taşıyor" Türkiye'nin Asya Kalkınma Bankası'ndan kısa sürede önemli miktarda finansman sağlamasının uluslararası kuruluşların ülkeye duyduğu güveni gösterdiğini belirten Arslan, kalkınma bankalarının işletme finansmanından ziyade altyapı yatırımlarına önem verdiğini söyledi. Arslan, "Demek ki Türkiye'de sağlamış olduğu kriterler açısından önemli gelişmeler göstermiş ki böyle bir durum söz konusu." değerlendirmesinde bulundu. COP31'in gündemindeki başlıklara da değinen Arslan, Türkiye'nin zirvede alınan ilke kararlarına hızla uyum sağlamasının önemine işaret ederek, "COP31 zirvesindeki konu başlıklarında alınan ilke kararlarına Türkiye'nin hızla adaptasyonu gerçekten diğer gelişmekte olan ülkeler için de veya az gelişmiş olan ülkeler için de bir rol model niteliği taşıyor." ifadelerini kullandı.

VakıfBank Genel Müdürü Osman Arslan, COP31 Zirvesi kapsamında CNBC-e ekranlarına yaptığı açıklamada, Türkiye'nin ev sahipliğinde gerçekleştirilen zirveye finans kuruluşlarının da yoğun ilgi gösterdiğini söyledi. items.articleText: Bitcoin'de sert düşüş: Son 3 ayın dibini gördü - itcoin, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran ile anlaşmaya ihtiyaç duymadıklarını açıklamasının ardından artan jeopolitik gerilim ve petrol fiyatlarındaki yükselişle yüzde 4,4 değer kaybetti. - 71 bin 390 dolara gerileyen Bitcoin, 20 Ağustos'tan bu yana en düşük seviyesini gördü. - Nvidia ve MSCI kaynaklı gelişmeler de kripto para piyasasındaki satış baskısını artırdı. Kripto para piyasasının en büyük varlığı Bitcoin'de satış baskısı hız kazandı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran ile anlaşma yapmak zorunda olmadıklarını açıklaması, piyasalarda jeopolitik risk algısını artırdı. Bitcoin'de kayıplar derinleşti Petrol fiyatlarının yükselmesi ve riskli varlıklardan çıkışların hızlanmasıyla Bitcoin yüzde 4,4 gerileyerek 71 bin 390 dolara kadar düştü. Böylece en büyük kripto para birimi, 20 Ağustos'tan bu yana en düşük seviyesini kaydetti. Küresel piyasalarda artan belirsizlik, yatırımcıların riskli varlıklara yönelik iştahını zayıflatırken kripto para piyasası da bu satış dalgasından etkilendi. Nvidia gelişmeleri satış baskısını artırdı Bitcoin üzerindeki baskıda yapay zeka sektörüne ilişkin endişeler de etkili oldu. ABD'li çip üreticisi Nvidia'nın CEO'su Jensen Huang'ın görevinden istifa ettiğine ilişkin açıklama, piyasalardaki tedirginliği artıran gelişmeler arasında yer aldı. Huang'ın ayrılığına ilişkin gelişmelerin büyük ölçüde önceden fiyatlandığı belirtilirken, yapay zeka yatırımlarının geleceğine yönelik belirsizliklerin risk iştahını olumsuz etkilediği değerlendirildi. Yapay zeka sektörüne ilişkin endişelerin teknoloji hisselerinin yanı sıra kripto para gibi yüksek riskli varlıklar üzerinde de baskı oluşturduğu görüldü. MSCI'ın Strategy kararı Bitcoin'i etkiledi Kripto para piyasasında satışları artıran bir diğer gelişme ise endeks sağlayıcısı MSCI'ın Strategy şirketine yönelik kararı oldu. Bitcoin rezervleriyle öne çıkan Strategy'nin MSCI endekslerinden çıkarılması kararı, şirket hisseleri ve dolaylı olarak Bitcoin piyasası açısından önemli bir gelişme olarak değerlendirildi. MSCI'ın kararı, Nvidia cephesindeki gelişmeler ve Trump'ın İran'a ilişkin açıklamalarıyla aynı döneme denk geldi. Birden fazla cepheden gelen olumsuz haber akışı, Bitcoin'deki satış baskısının derinleşmesine yol açtı. Gözler Bitcoin'de yeni destek seviyelerinde Bitcoin'in 71 bin 390 dolara kadar gerilemesiyle birlikte yatırımcıların odağı, fiyatın hangi seviyelerde tutunabileceğine çevrildi. Jeopolitik gelişmeler, petrol fiyatları ve küresel piyasalardaki risk iştahı, kripto para piyasasının yönü açısından belirleyici başlıklar arasında yer alıyor. Strategy neden önemli? Strategy, bilançosunda yüksek miktarda Bitcoin bulundurmasıyla bilinen halka açık bir şirket. Şirketin MSCI endekslerinden çıkarılması, endeksleri takip eden fonların Strategy hisselerine yönelik yatırımlarını etkileyebilecek bir gelişme olarak öne çıkıyor. Bu nedenle karar, Bitcoin piyasası açısından da yakından izleniyor.

items.title: Poundland gets more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
items.summary: A deadline to secure a buyer was set to expire at midnight, but the retailer now has an extra 10 days to find a buyer.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Poundland gets more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
items.summaryTr: A deadline to secure a buyer was set to expire at midnight, but the retailer now has an extra 10 days to find a buyer.
items.articleText: Poundland gets more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue - Published Poundland has avoided immediate collapse after a deadline was extended to find a rescue deal. A deadline to secure a buyer for the retail chain was set to expire at midnight, but a court has given Poundland an extra 10 days to find a buyer. The discount chain, which has 11,000 employees, has been edging towards administration after being blocked by owners Gordon Brothers from accessing cash in its bank accounts. A committee of MPs questioned Gordon Brothers following accusations that the investment firm hoped to profit from selling off Poundland's 600 shops and stock piecemeal. Gordon Brothers - which bought the chain for just £1 last year - is accused of forcing that outcome by restricting Poundland's access to available cash needed to restock shops, and pay wages and rent, ahead of the crucial Christmas trading period. The investment firm, which specialises in buying and restructuring distressed companies, has denied the claims. However, pressure remains on Poundland's owners after a takeover bid was rejected. The decision prompted calls for answers from politicians, including Prime Minister Andy Burnham. About £50m had been frozen by Gordon Brothers, the BBC understands, meaning Poundland bosses were unable to restock shelves across its 600 shops. The BBC understands that Gordon Brothers agreed to release a further £10m to £11m from Poundland's accounts, on top of £11m announced earlier, as the firm seeks to find a new buyer. Gordon Brothers said it was in talks with three parties for a sale of the whole business, and it had received "several offers from established high street retailers for significant parts of the business". 'Do the right thing' Following the meeting between MPs on the business and trade committee and representatives of Gordon Brothers, chairman Liam Byrne told the BBC that he was "deeply concerned" and described the firm's behaviour as "much like a wolf on Wall Street, on the British High Street". "They refused to prioritise protecting jobs and stores over and above their own financial returns," he said. "It's clear that they've taken millions out of Poundland at a time when they themselves said the business was on a knife edge." Byrne said the committee's message to Gordon Brothers was to ensure Poundland had "access to the funds that it needs to trade at what should be one of the busiest periods in the year". He urged Gordon Brothers to "do what is right to save jobs and stores and do that now". "It's a good business, it's a much-loved business and, particularly in the middle of the cost of living crisis, communities up and down the country rely on access to the kind of stores that it operates," Byrne added. Views on Poundland performance differ Views on the chain's performance differ between those running operations and the owners. Poundland boss Williams told staff last week that like-for-like sales, which exclude new store openings, were up 11.4%. The sales period included Halloween, but Williams said this was £1.5m ahead of budget. He added that the business made a profit of £18.1m in the year to September, which was a "strong recovery" from the previous year when there were losses of £68m. However, Gordon Brothers has painted a different picture, saying the chain remains "challenged and vulnerable to any potential downturn in future trading". It has argued that the best way of securing jobs may be to split up the business and sell chunks of its 600 sites to other retailers. There has been interest from the likes of Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M in picking up Poundland shops, which could mean continuing employment for workers at those sites. The main issue is whether a piecemeal sale would protect more jobs than a buyer willing to keep Poundland as a national chain. Get in touch Are you affected by issues discussed in this story? items.title: Before Scott Colom, these two men were the last black US senators from Mississippi
items.summary: The Democratic candidate won in a southern state that had not seated a black senator since 1874.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Before Scott Colom, these two men were the last black US senators from Mississippi
items.summaryTr: The Democratic candidate won in a southern state that had not seated a black senator since 1874.
items.articleText: Before Scott Colom, these two men were the last black US senators from Mississippi - Published After winning a close race in Mississippi, Democrat Scott Colom will become the state's first black US senator for more than 150 years, and the third in history. It is a historic result in the deeply conservative southern state that last sent a Democrat to the US Senate in 1982, and had not seated a black senator since 1875. Colom follows Hiram Revels, who became the first black person ever to serve in the chamber when he was seated from 1870 to 1871, and Blanche Bruce, whose term ran from 1875 to 1881. Revels was chosen as Mississippi's first senator after the Civil War, serving for just over a year and campaigning strongly for racial equality. A few years later, Bruce, who was born into slavery, became the first black person to serve a full term in the US Senate. He remained in Washington after leaving the chamber and held a role in the Treasury. Both terms came before the repressive Jim Crow laws began to enforce racial segregation across Mississippi and other southern US states. A significant factor in Colom's victory was his success in mobilising young people and the state's large black population, who are expected to have turned out in high numbers. In a victory speech, Colom referenced how Revels, who was a minister and served as a chaplain during the Civil War, gained support for his Senate campaign through his words. "That's an example of the power of prayer, and through our history, there are so many people that lifted this state up through the power of prayer in very dark times," Colom said. Prior to the result being called, the BBC spoke to students at Jackson State University, a historically black college in Mississippi. Many of them had voted for the first time and backed Colom. "I really feel like a change is what we need," 18-year-old Jamyria Dunn said. "I've had some amazing days in my life," she continued, "but seeing Mississippi, this state in particular, turn blue, would really bring a light to my heart that people just would not understand."

items.titleTr: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge
items.summaryTr: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.
items.articleText: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor. Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as president and CEO and stepped down from the company’s board on Thursday, effective immediately. The board named Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress interim CEO. Kress will retain her role as CFO while Nvidia’s board considers internal and external candidates for the permanent CEO role. The board also appointed Harvey C. Jones its first chair and said it expects Nvidia’s operations to proceed without interruption. Nvidia shares fell more than 13% at the US market open on Thursday, trading at $151.00 as of 2:31 p.m. UTC, according to Yahoo Finance. Kress has served as Nvidia’s CFO since September 2013 and previously held finance positions at Cisco and Microsoft. Nvidia is scheduled to report its fiscal 2027 third-quarter financial results on Nov. 17. Huang’s resignation follows foreign intelligence investigation Huang’s departure comes just four days after Nvidia’s board announced an independent investigation amid reports that the company’s co-founder had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. The board said it had no reason to believe US national security or Nvidia’s confidential information had been compromised, but would examine all available information. In a separate message to employees that day, Huang acknowledged an extramarital affair and apologized to his family and colleagues. He also pledged to cooperate with the investigation. On Tuesday, Nvidia’s independent directors retained former acting US Attorney Joon H. Kim and law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct the inquiry. Nvidia’s rise to $5.5 trillion under Huang Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and served as its CEO for more than 33 years, overseeing its transformation from a graphics-chip maker into a leading supplier of AI processors. His departure marks the first CEO transition in the company’s history. Nvidia’s market capitalization surged from approximately $57.5 billion at the end of 2016 to a peak of $5.5 trillion on Sept. 1, 2026, a nearly 96-fold increase, according to data from Stock Analysis. Huang’s personal fortune has also declined amid Nvidia’s stock selloff. His estimated net worth fell from $162.2 billion on Nov. 9 to $140.6 billion as of 3:42 p.m. UTC on Thursday. items.titleTr: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
items.summaryTr: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.
items.articleText: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang - Published A senior leader of Colombia's largest criminal gang, the Gulf Clan, is among eight people killed in an air strike carried out by the country's armed forces, according to President Abelardo de la Espriella. De la Espriella said he had personally authorised the bombing targeting the Gulf Clan in the province of Antioquia, in north-west Colombia. He added that Haminton Mosquera, whom he described as a senior member of the crime gang and one of 10 "priority targets" for Colombia's security forces, had been "brought down". De la Espriella was elected in June after campaigning on a promise to crack down on Colombia's powerful criminal gangs, including by launching air strikes. In a post on X, external, he said that Mosquera was suspected of having ordered attacks against the security forces, including the murder of a police officer in the municipality of Tarazá last year. The Gulf Clan has been engaging in criminal activities for decades, mainly trafficking cocaine from Colombia to destinations in the US and Europe but also illegal mining and people smuggling. The US added it to its list of Foreign Terrorist Organisations (FTOs) last year. In his post, President de la Espriella said that "the offensive won't stop" and vowed to regain control of areas currently controlled by criminal organisations such as the Gulf Clan. While his offensive against criminal gangs has been welcomed by many living in areas where extortion and gang violence are rampant, de la Espriella has faced criticism for the way he has made some of his announcements on security. Less than a month after taking office, he published a video showing him walking among 23 body bags containing the remains of 23 people killed in an air strike on a suspected guerrilla camp. On Wednesday, he shared a photo, external in which he can be seen writing his campaign slogan, "Welcome to the miracle homeland" on a bomb. He has also defended his decision to wear an army uniform at a recent event in Cúcuta at which he confronted a detainee suspected of being a Farc rebel. "What did you make of the bomb I sent you, signed by me?," the president can be heard asking the man. He later told journalists that he wore the uniform because "I am a soldier of the homeland. That's why I dress like a soldier, because I came to serve Colombia. Because I honour the heroes, police officers and military." Additional reporting by BBC Monitoring's Luis Fajardo. - Published9 September

items.articleText: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall. Shares in Nasdaq-listed Bit Digital fell 9.3% in premarket trading on Thursday after the Ethereum treasury and AI infrastructure company reported third-quarter revenue below analysts’ estimates. Bit Digital reported $27.1 million in revenue, down 11% from $30.5 million a year earlier. Net income attributable to shareholders was $28.5 million, or 8 cents per diluted share, according to its Thursday SEC filing. The company’s revenue came in nearly 16% below analyst consensus estimates of about $32.2 million, marking a $5.1 million shortfall, according to Yahoo Finance. Bit Digital reported $1 million in Ether (ETH) staking revenue, down about 66% from $2.9 million a year ago. The company reported holdings equivalent to about 163,726 ETH, worth $439.4 million as of Sept. 30. Its Bitcoin mining revenue fell to $2 million from $7.4 million a year earlier. Bit Digital said that the decline in mining revenue was “consistent with the continued winddown of the business.” The company revealed it pivoted its corporate treasury strategy from Bitcoin to Ether in July 2025. Related: Bit Digital buys $20M worth of Ethereum, expands treasury to 158K ETH

items.titleTr: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
items.summaryTr: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.
items.articleText: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own. Thailand’s securities regulator has proposed capping daily stablecoin deposits and withdrawals at 5 million baht ($148,000) each per customer at regulated crypto operators. The limit would apply separately to deposits and withdrawals at each operator, Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said in a Thursday announcement. The regulator said the rules aim to curb money laundering, cybercrime and attempts to bypass cross-border money transfer rules. The draft would bar stablecoin transfers to and from third-party wallets. Operators would have to verify that customers own the accounts or wallets they use for deposits and withdrawals. Operators would have to comply with the Travel Rule, which requires crypto service providers to collect and share information about transfers, and use blockchain analytics to identify wallets linked to suspicious activity. The draft would require crypto exchanges to name their market makers and identify the assets for which they provide liquidity. Crypto brokers would be barred from using liquidity providers for stablecoin-baht pairs. Certain off-platform trades would be subject to a 3 million baht minimum. The draft follows a September consultation in which the SEC proposed stablecoin transfer limits and tighter oversight of crypto operators. Related: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading

items.summary: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.

items.titleTr: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
items.summaryTr: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.
items.articleText: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director. Hackers stole 57 cents for every $1 earned onchain by blockchain protocols since 2017, according to Lorenzo Valente, director of digital asset research at ARK Investment Management. “Security is the bottleneck,” wrote Valente in a Thursday X post, sharing a chart showing that $8.7 billion lost to crypto hacks year to date had already surpassed the $5.6 billion in estimated annual onchain revenue for 2026. Since 2017, the crypto industry has lost about $26.9 billion to hacks and earned $47 billion in total onchain revenue, he added. The recent $6.3 billion stolen in the Binance hack alone exceeded Valente’s estimate for full-year 2026 onchain revenue. Value lost to hacks is on track to exceed onchain revenue by year-end for the first time since 2020. The crypto industry saw a string of high-value hacks this year, including September’s $387 million Bitget hack and the $320 million Liquid Network exploit, as well as April’s $295 million Drift Protocol exploit. The mounting security exploits are weighing on the institutional appetite for DeFi. In an April research note, JPMorgan analysts identified bridge security as a long-standing challenge for the industry. Total value locked in decentralized finance (DeFi) has fallen nearly 10% since the Binance exploit, from $85.9 billion on Oct. 29 to $77.4 billion on Thursday, according to DefiLlama. Related: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys

items.title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
items.summary: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.

items.titleTr: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
items.summaryTr: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.
items.articleText: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist. Running an independent blockchain has always come with a particular promise: control. A standalone Layer 1 architecture allows projects to be the masters of their own destiny, set the rules of consensus, maintain their own validators and build infrastructure around their users, without relying on any other network. But with great power comes great responsibility — and considerable expense. Blockchains need enough users, developers and economic activity to support the infrastructure that secures them. For some smaller networks, keeping an entire ecosystem afloat no longer makes economic sense. Zilliqa is the latest project to confront that reality, announcing plans last week to move away from its L1 architecture and become an Ethereum-based Layer 2 (L2) instead: “We know it’s not great. For nine years we built and ran our own Layer 1. It hasn’t worked.” “Usage never reached what a standalone chain needs,” the post explained. “Funding and liquidity for standalone L1s dried up. The recent hacks showed how much it takes to secure a chain alone. The data is onchain for everyone to see.” Zilliqa is not alone. Blockchain ecosystem Gnosis (which has always been Ethereum-adjacent) is also working to transition Gnosis Chain into an Ethereum-based network through its Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ) initiative. Its RollupX test network intends to show how participating chains can share Ethereum settlement and synchronous composability as native rollups. Gaming-focused Ronin blockchain also completed its move back to Ethereum as an L2 in May. With interest in alt L1s drying up along with the funding, will we start to see more and more chains consolidating in the Ethereum ecosystem? The cost of going it alone Independent L1s generally have to keep several core functions going, including execution, consensus, data availability and settlement. They must also fund the token incentives used to secure their networks through staking. Related: What are native rollups? Full guide to Ethereum’s latest innovation “It comes down to a chain’s profitability,” Max Shannon, senior research analyst at Bitwise, tells Magazine. ZIL becomes a Layer 2 on Ethereum. Source: Zilliqa “L2s only need to maintain execution and do not necessarily need a token, which makes them a more attractive financial and operational proposition,” he says. Shannon says the top ten largest projects are more financially sustainable. Coinbase and Robinhood’s L2 networks generated $48 million and $52 million in fees respectively over the last 365 days, with margins above 90%. The next eight largest chains each generated more than $1 million annually. From 11th place onward, however, annual fees collectively amounted to less than $1 million. So a network may have ambitious technology and a dedicated community, but those things don’t necessarily pay the bills. Ethereum is often criticized for giving away too much of its revenue to L2s, but that’s precisely what makes it attractive to set up projects there. But just becoming an Ethereum L2 doesn’t automatically make a network profitable however. Shannon points to Optimism, Katana and Linea as examples of networks whose expenses outweigh their fee revenue. Projects like Blast have already been forced to shut down. Ethereum as a liquidity ‘black hole’ Gnosis has targeted spring 2027 to complete its transition, which will see it give up its independent validator-based consensus in favor of Ethereum settlement. Gnosis Chain will relaunch as an Ethereum Economic Zone. Source: Gnosis “Two years ago I gave a talk about ‘native Rollups’ that would truly extend Ethereum instead of being isolated chains,” co-founder Martin Köppelmann said, adding that RollupX “even goes beyond what I had imagined back then!” Gnosis’s EEZ initiative aims to enable separate Ethereum-based networks interact synchronously, so a smart contract on one network can call another and use its response within the same transaction, without relying on the usual bridge-and-wait process. That’s a prospect that has some Ethereum supporters particularly bullish, with ETH bull materkel describing the EEZ as a potential “black hole for liquidity,” and saying it could allow participating networks to tap into Ethereum’s total value locked (TVL) and strengthen its position as a liquidity hub. Could network effects, and increased interoperability draw more and more chains into Ethereum’s orbit? Beyond the cost savings It isn’t only the operating cost economics that make sense. Projects can also tap into an established ecosystem of applications and developers rather than building those network effects from scratch. Related: Privacy tools are rising behind institutional adoption, says ZKsync dev Alex Gluchowski, co-founder and chief executive of Matter Labs, the company behind Ethereum L2 ZKsync, says he expects more L1 teams to maintain their own chains while using Ethereum for settlement. “Running an independent L1 means maintaining its security as well as building something people want to use,” Gluchowski tells Magazine. “Sharing Ethereum’s security gives a team more room to focus on its users. I see very few user needs that require an independent L1 rather than an Ethereum-based chain.” But Gluchowski says sovereignty and Ethereum integration are not mutually exclusive, since chains can retain control over their rules and operations while using Ethereum for shared settlement. Ronin completed migration to Ethereum in May. Source: Ronin And for applications handling sensitive financial information, maintaining a private environment under their own control can be essential, he says. Shared settlement does not have to mean exposing confidential transaction data. The biggest obstacle today is that all the L2s are effectively isolated from each other and from Ethereum. It’s certainly possible to jump between them, but its far from seamless and interoperability is poor. “Fragmentation is already happening,” Gluchowski says, pointing to the difficulty of connecting networks when transactions involve privacy. Interoperability between private environments will become more important as more applications seek to combine confidential activity with access to public blockchain liquidity, he says. Does every chain need Ethereum? Shannon cautions against describing the market as undergoing straightforward consolidation around Ethereum. Some large institutions are launching L2 networks, he says, including Coinbase and Robinhood, but others are still choosing to build independent L1s, like Circle’s Arc, Stripe’s Tempo, or Hyperliquid’s purpose-specific perpetual futures blockchain. “So there is no clear conclusion to the L1 versus L2 debate as yet,” he says. That’s a prospect that has some Ethereum supporters particularly bullish, with ETH bull materkel describing the EEZ as a potential “black hole for liquidity,” and saying it could allow participating networks to tap into Ethereum’s total value locked (TVL) and strengthen its position as a liquidity hub. Could network effects, and increased interoperability draw more and more chains into Ethereum’s orbit? Beyond the cost savings It isn’t only the operating cost economics that make sense. Projects can also tap into an established ecosystem of applications and developers rather than building those network effects from scratch. Related: Privacy tools are rising behind institutional adoption, says ZKsync dev Alex Gluchowski, co-founder and chief executive of Matter Labs, the company behind Ethereum L2 ZKsync, says he expects more L1 teams to maintain their own chains while using Ethereum for settlement. “Running an independent L1 means maintaining its security as well as building something people want to use,” Gluchowski tells Magazine. “Sharing Ethereum’s security gives a team more room to focus on its users. I see very few user needs that require an independent L1 rather than an Ethereum-based chain.” But Gluchowski says sovereignty and Ethereum integration are not mutually exclusive, since chains can retain control over their rules and operations while using Ethereum for shared settlement. Ronin completed migration to Ethereum in May. Source: Ronin And for applications handling sensitive financial information, maintaining a private environment under their own control can be essential, he says. Shared settlement does not have to mean exposing confidential transaction data. The biggest obstacle today is that all the L2s are effectively isolated from each other and from Ethereum. It’s certainly possible to jump between them, but its far from seamless and interoperability is poor. “Fragmentation is already happening,” Gluchowski says, pointing to the difficulty of connecting networks when transactions involve privacy. Interoperability between private environments will become more important as more applications seek to combine confidential activity with access to public blockchain liquidity, he says. Does every chain need Ethereum? Shannon cautions against describing the market as undergoing straightforward consolidation around Ethereum. Some large institutions are launching L2 networks, he says, including Coinbase and Robinhood, but others are still choosing to build independent L1s, like Circle’s Arc, Stripe’s Tempo, or Hyperliquid’s purpose-specific perpetual futures blockchain. “So there is no clear conclusion to the L1 versus L2 debate as yet,” he says.
